sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 16544 of 2023
Applicant :- Rajkumar Yadav

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Surendra Mohan Mishra,Vishveshwar Mani Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vishwarmani Tripathi, learned counsel for applicant, Suresh Bahadur Singh, learned
A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
198 of 2022, under Sections 376-D, 366, 328, 323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station- Jogiya Udaypur,
District- Siddharth Nagar during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. F.I.R. of the present case was lodged on 11.11.2022 against applicant and five others and according to the F.I.R. on 27.6.2022 and 1.7.2022 applicant and his brother Vijay Kumar Yadav and Vishal Yadav committed rape with the victim 4.

Learned counsel for applicant submits according to the F.I.R. twice victim was raped by applicant and his brother Vijay Kumar Yadav and co-accused Vishal Yadav on 27.6.2022 and 1.7.2022 but in spite of that F.I.R. of the present case was lodged on 11.11.2022 i.e. after about 4-1/2 months from the date of first incident of rape and this fact clearly suggests that entire allegation made against applicant in the F.I.R. is totally false and frivolous.

sentences.text:
He further submitted that in the F.I.R. it is specifically narrated by the victim that on 1.7.2022 applicant and co-accused Vijay Kumar, the brother of the applicant and co-accused Vishal Yadav committed rape with her and after hearing her shreak her parents and other villagers arrived at the spot and taken her to home and when the statement of father of the victim was recorded then he narrated entirely different story to the police in his statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and stated that victim/informant was having love affair with co-accused Vijay Kumar Yadav (brother of applicant) and on 27.6.2022 i.e. on the date of first incident of rape and on 1.7.2022 i.e. on the second date of incident of rape victim remained absent from her home and when on 1.7.2022 she did not reach home then he searched her and found his daughter i.e. victim along with co-accused Vijay Kumar Yadav i.e. brother of the applicant in objectionable condition and thereafter Panchyat was held in the village and a settlement arrived between the parties to the effect that total rupees six lacs will be paid by father of applicant and co-accused Vijay Kumar Yadav and he received Rs.
50,000/- but when he could not receive the remaining amount then he went along with his daughter to the court and thereafter F.I.R. of the present case was lodged and therefore, from the perusal of the statement of the father of the victim it appears that entire F.I.R. is based on false and fabricated fact.
6. He further submitted although victim in her both the Statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. repeated the version of F.I.R. but in the light of the statement of her father her statement cannnot be relied upon.
7.
He further submits he has annexed compromise executed between father of the applicant and informant as annexure-8 to the affidavit.
8. He next submitted applicant is not having any criminal history and is languishing in jail since 06.02.2023, therefore, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

9. Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that in the F.I.R. as well as in both the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. there is allegation of rape against applicant and his brother Vijay Kumar Yadav and another co-accused Vishal Yadav but learned A.G.A. could not dispute the fact that F.I.R. of the present case was lodged belatedly after about four months and further the father of victim in his statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. categorically stated that there was love affair between victim and brother of the applicant i.e.
co-accused Vijay Kumar Yadav and a compromise was executed between the parties and father of applicant agreed to rupees six lacs to the father of victim but he only received Rs. 50,000/- from him and, therefore, the instant F.I.R. was lodged.
10. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. It is a case in which in the F.I.R. and in the Statement of victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. there is allegation of rape against three persons including applicant and his brother and another co-accused Vishal Yadav but from perusal of the statement of father of the victim which was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. it appears that victim was having love affair with Vijay Kumar Yadav, the brother of applicant and a compromise was executed between father of Rajkumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195542820/

sentences.text: the victim and father of applicant, father of applicant agreed to pay rupees six lacs to the father of the victim but out of Rs. Six lacs he only received Rs. 50,000/- and, therefore, the F.I.R. of the present case was lodged, therefore, considering the statement of father of the victim and the compromise executed between the father of applicant and father of the victim, which has been annexed as Annnexure-8 to the affidavit, in my opinion, applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
12. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant- Raj Kumar Yadav be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Kumar Manish.
